label: Sprint Planning Assistant
description: Facilitates sprint planning by estimating stories, checking team capacity, identifying dependencies, and generating a sprint plan with clear goals and success criteria.

claudeKnowledge.description: Scrum framework, agile estimation techniques, sprint planning best practices, velocity tracking

guidedInputs.label: Sprint number and dates
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g. Sprint 14 — 24 February to 7 March 2025 (2 weeks)

guidedInputs.label: Team capacity
guidedInputs.placeholder:
List team members and their available capacity for this sprint.
e.g.
- Anna (Backend): 8 days (2 days leave)
- Erik (Frontend): 10 days
- Sofia (QA): 10 days
- Marcus (DevOps): 5 days (part-time)
- Total: 33 team-days | Historical velocity: ~45 story points

guidedInputs.label: Candidate backlog items
guidedInputs.placeholder:
List the stories/tasks being considered for this sprint. Include any existing estimates if available.
e.g.
- US-142: User authentication via SSO (8 SP, Backend+Frontend)
- US-156: Export to PDF functionality (5 SP, Frontend+Backend)
- BUG-089: Fix dashboard loading error on Safari (3 SP, Frontend)
- US-161: Admin user management screen (8 SP, Frontend)
- TECH-034: Upgrade database driver to v5 (5 SP, Backend+DevOps)
- US-165: Email notification system (13 SP, Backend)

guidedInputs.label: Proposed sprint goal (optional)
guidedInputs.placeholder: What is the primary business objective for this sprint? e.g. Complete user authentication flow so beta users can log in with company SSO.

guidedInputs.label: Dependencies and blockers
guidedInputs.placeholder:
Any known dependencies between stories, external dependencies, or current blockers.
e.g. US-142 must complete before US-161 (auth required for user management). PDF export (US-156) blocked on design sign-off — expected 25 Feb.

guidedInputs.label: Carryover from previous sprint
guidedInputs.placeholder: List any incomplete stories being carried over from the previous sprint with remaining estimate.
